title: Tips and singers in the cabarets
summary: Albertson asks about tips; Wooding says he was not yet playing for singers, and that singers split tips with the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And, well, first of all, the Bucket of Blood, now, what about tips. Because a lot of performers in those days told me they made more money in tips than in salary.
Oh, you mean in the cabaret.
OH. Well, we hadn't worked up to no singers.
I still wasnt playing for singing yet, Because I couldnt play that well.
So, when you worked for a singer, the singer collected the tips and shared them with you, right?
Oh, yes, then they split it up with the band.
